I'm going to share some thoughts, reinitiated by last update and what was posted the last days.
Mostly triggered by whoever posted the book (the page that reads like an experiment protocol) and the idea of the city being kind of a "Truman Show"

Now that i think about it, there's a funny connection between what i'm going to talk about and the "Truman Show", which/who is actor Ed Harris.

This idea came up while watching the event, which might literally be called "The Scary Room", back in one of the Dorm Wars, or "The" Dorm war because... maybe first.
Where Maya has to go into the scary room prepared by Ami as a contest against, who was it? Tsuneyo? Whatever.

While i first watched it, it reminded me of Westworld (hence the connection through Ed Harris).
That was because of the situation with the angels and how Maya, at least seemingly, isn't aware of their presence.
Or she is and just ignores them, would also tell a tale.
For those who watched Westworld, it's about how Host's where observed without them perceiving human beings around them. Like when they were trained for new scenarios or while in maintenance mode.

One more thing A)
There is also how Maya seems to know or at least expects someone to be in charge of everything, or even takes them as a deity. Which i guess is user2/wire god or at least a being on the same level and pretending to be U2.
She's not surprised that there is someone/thing who/which could reset her. This also leads to another rabbit hole where Maya always knew way more then she ever told anyone.

One more thing B)
Ami was the one who prepared Maya's scary room.
Maya seems to see something (coming from a projector?), what she claims shouldn't exist anymore.
Combining with one angel stating "I prefer her in another position" iirc, i think Maya was confronted with sex pictures of her and Akira, probably from her loli age, which found their way there through Ami who took them from Akira's phone.
I can only guess that Ami was trying to intimidate Maya or get a lever on her.

So back to West-/Kumon'miworld (Hint or ruse, i'm not sure)

There a couple of things that could really fit well into such scenario.

-The picture of the opened book recently, seems to be some kind of research protocol.
-That could make whole Kumon'mi into a testing field. A labrat labyrinth.
-The Walls? Confinement.
-The Spacewar? An excuse for Kumon'mi inhabitants not trying to escape or questioning the confinement.
(Rantmode: Spacewar huh? Doesn't seem to also take place on "earth", so why the walls? To avoid panic? Keep people in check?, crippling economy? Makes no sense if you want to fuel a "Space War". Besides, Space War? with what? Tech back on earth seems pretty nowadays, so what would they fight possible space faring aliens with?)
-The door to salvation in the woods? Could be a service entrance like in Westworld to Administration/Research Devision.
Akira and Nao-Chan got caught. Akira got that experience wiped and Nao-Chan got a more severe treatment.
-Nodoka mentioning a world "above" Kumon'mi.
-Gods wanting to experience emotions through Akira? Maybe scientists studiying interactions.
-Nao-Chan having powers like Maeve. (Making things go dead)
-Resets? Times when inhabitants get retrieved back for data extraction/maintenace or whatever. Whould explain why there are almost no other people around during resets.
Would also explain why Akira has to go through trials. He's tested.
-Different seasons? Different Scientists in charge of diffrerent experimental trials.
(Might continue list later)

I wondered for some time know, how back at the beginnging of lil, there where only (afaik) black silhouettes for non important characters.
Then we got, what i assume were Ami, Ayane, Maya, Sekai during a reset event as colored silhouettes.
Nowadays we get more and more colored silhouettes during events.
Maybe those are visitors to the Kumon'mi experiment or scientists? Or core characters that are not part of the experiment?

Going with that scenario there a at least a couple important questions.
Are Kumon'mi inhabitants human, Machines/Androids/Hosts or even hybrids.
Himawari seems to be special, among others maybe.
Problem is, how is Himawari in her teens?
If she and her parents are human we might have lost several years between resets.
Or she's a machine and developed way faster by whatever means.
Maybe offspring created in Kumon'mi gets "harvested" for studying.
And Himawari was enlisted to help with the study.

Ami seems to already be hanging out with Maya:
Ami - "Maybe another time. I already told one of my friends I'd meet up with them and...probably shouldn't immediately back out."
- "It's fine. It's just Maya I'm meeting up with anyway."
So, they are probably fine. Maya only really gives a shit about Ami and Sensei, so this was inevitable.

Noriko is supposedly Ami's "sister" along with Niki:
Ami - "Sensei! I have sisters now!"
And has apparently always planned to live happily ever after with Ami and Sensei:
Noriko - "Because in my master plan, we all live happily ever after together."
So, I can definitely see this relationship growing. Especially with Niki being important to Ami, and all 3 being important to Sensei.

Futaba doesn't really seem in the mood for friends lately. Even a little annoyed by Rin it seems. Albeit, she's cozying up to Otoha now which is... strange.

A little out of left field, but Nodoka and Otoha might be getting closer to Ami soon. Not only are they into incest, depravity, and Sensei, they also know about her mother, and Nodoka, in particular, is interested in Ami:
Nodoka - "I know many things, Akira. But none of them particularly matter to me. And I'd be happy to tell you why I've been following your adorable niece around, but..."
- "Perhaps another day, when I think you're capable of taking a bigger hit, I'll share it with you."
- "Ami Arakawa is the daughter of the Girl Who Cannot Breathe."
They also both have some relation to Niki. Sensei even seems to struggle between choosing Niki and Nodoka:
Sensei Narrator - "I should call Niki again. I can take my feelings out on her."
- "Or Nodoka."
- "No. Not Nodoka. Niki."
- "No matter how much I want to puke in her mouth."
So, this is sure to cause some drama. Who knows, Nodoka might even be trying to be Ami's "sister" soon as well. She already calls Sensei "papa".

Otoha also seems interested in Maya, Niki, and Sensei, and has some connection to Sekai. It seems like she'll probably get involved with Ami at some point.

Overall: I doubt the "burned bridges" will be that big of the deal. Most of these girls just want Sensei's dick and don't really see Ami as much more than a way to get it, which isn't exactly new to her:
Ami - "Were you just using me to get to Sensei as well? Is that all everyone does nowadays? Because it sure seems like it."
Ami's relationship with Uta might be a little different now due to the whole breaking into her house, trying to kidnap Sensei, and having her wizard pic on Sensei's phone stuff, though.

Ami will also probably be wary of Chika, in particular, since she sees her as possibly the most obsessed:
Ami - "No, I don't think she is. In fact, I'm starting to think she's the most obsessed out of all of you."
Still, they will both probably play nice because it's beneficial.

In the end, it'll really just depend on if Sensei will honor his word and prioritize Ami now:
Sensei - "You're my number one priority now, Ami."
Otherwise things will probably just repeat themselves, and none of what's happened will matter much.

spoilers.title: A LOT about Niki
spoilers.html:
As time goes by I get increasingly intrigued by her character. There is the obvious "this person doesn't even seem real", given to us by Himawari. But it just goes beyond that, in the sense that who even is Akira to her? She dated this teenager when she was also a teenager, and probably knew Ami, Sekai and his brother given that they were dating. Then his family died and he had to take care of his niece, so she probably interprets that as the whole tragedy and reason for breaking up.

Then she gets her sister to be tutored by her ex, even though she still loved him, but nothing comes of that either. Then she goes on to never move on from him, but doesn't seek him out either (????). I still can't comprehend how that is, I mean, for a kid Noriko to be unable to find him is one thing, but for an adult to be obssessed to the point of writing her songs about him, and not even care to track him to know if he's okay - but instead create the delusion of "no, i'm gonna make HIM come to me" idk.

Regardless, then as Noriko finds him again she just strolls into his life, and even though she says she knows what he likes and is super sexual about it, does she really? Cause Akira is mainly a product of sexual abuse by Sekai, even becoming a teacher too, hell, even his relationship with Niki might have been either a reaction or motivated by Sekai. Then the whole thing with Maya, where he has this child living with him and having sex with her on the same place where he tutors her younger sister.

And then, to top it all off, and back to your point of comparison between Nodoka and Niki, it is bizarre to me that not even Noriko, but Nodoka should probably know more about Akira than Niki does. Wakana does to some extent as well. A lot of the girls know glimpses (also having sex with him, which Niki has no idea about), and Niki is just "yeah, that's my teenage boyfriend that lost his family to a car crash, I'm willing to accept anything he did or does as long as it isn't raising his voice to me when I come to his house at his niece's request, without informing him".

Do you really, Niki? I'm not sure to be honest. She's just so off, if I remember correctly she asks if Akira is still a virgin, and he wasn't a virgin even when she met him for the first time. Then this same virgin idol is kissed by Otoha (even though she's been saving herself completely to Akira for more than 15 years) and isn't even hard enough with her for that imo (given that it should matter more to her obssession that someone else defiled her mouth instead of him - otherwise it wouldn't be that much of an obssession), and then is asking random women to the bed with her and Akira too, when she was a virgin and had no experience until last week?

All of this to say that Noriko would be a better match to current Akira, and Nodoka would be a better match to unload anything (cause I'm really not sure Niki would be able to take even a portion of it), and that the only thing Niki would really be good at is being a mother to Ami and if Akira, by some miracle, just closed the lid on all the events that made him who he is, and moved on to happy family no incest time (cause I don't think Niki could handle that either).

DeSkel15 said:
Basically the timeline seems to be:
  • Sensei becomes a Tutor
  • Niki mentions it to her family (currently dating)
  • Noriko gets tutored and develops a crush (she's implied to be 6)
  • Accident happens
  • Sensei stops coming around
  • Seemingly soon after, tutors again, letting Noriko back into his life but not Niki (ghosts her)
  • Short time later (now revealed to be within months), Maya shows up.
  • Years later, Sensei and Maya disappear (almost 5 years ago)
  • Noriko begins her search

  • Wakana tries to get rid of her, Noriko reunites with Sensei, and Maya, who calls her a cunt.

Click to expand...

DeSkel15 said:
Otoha: It was recently shown that Nodoka knows that Otoha knows who the Girl Who Cannot Breathe (Aka Sekai and Ami's mom) is:
View attachment 3600954 View attachment 3600955 View attachment 3600956 View attachment 3600958 Nodoka - "Ami Arakawa is the daughter of the Girl Who Cannot Breathe."
Otoha - "I don't know who-"
Nodoka - "Don't lie to me, Otoha."
- "I know you so I know you know."
Otoha however is apparently trying to hide this.

Otoha also seems to see Sensei as a little brother, while he was Sekai's little brother in law. Both Sekai and Otoha also seem to be shotacons, and shitty when it comes to love. There's something strange going on here, but it's not clear what or why.

Niki and Noriko grew up with Sensei. They were next door neighbors and he was basically a part of their family long before he dated Niki, and since he was "with" Sekai at least:
View attachment 3600973 View attachment 3600969 View attachment 3600974 Niki - "We grew up together. Shit, you basically lived at my house."
Noriko - "You were like another member of the family."
Sekai - "Now stop worrying and finish your homework or that pink haired friend of yours is going to get mad at you again."

When Sensei was around 18 and Niki 16, they dated for 5 years, then the accident happened, Sensei ghosted her, and after 8 years they reunited.

Some stuff on Noriko:


Overall: The Nakayamas are basically family. Niki is like a younger bigger sister and Noriko a little sister. Niki is also his childhood best friend who he used to watch anime and go play in the woods with.

Sensei has tried to hide things from Niki mostly because he cares about her and doesn't want her to see how he really is. He doesn't feel like he deserves her. Niki is basically everything that is good for him. Nodoka is the opposite. She makes him feel numb. Niki makes him want to be better. They are basically the Dark side (Nodoka) vs the Light side (Niki) imo. Nodoka wants him to accept his horribleness. Niki wants him to grow up.
Click to expand...
I see, well, that helps with Niki - but if all about her is indeed true, she's gonna be torn apart when the truth comes out. There are shattering revelations about what has controlled her life since forever that she has no idea about. That, or she'll soldier on regardless, and if so, more respect for her. She already said that she's too deep to have any chance of going back now, regardless of what happens.

And regarding Otoha, now that would be VERY interesting, and finally give me reason to care about her - which I've been trying to do for a long time. I wonder how Sekai feels about Niki too, I was reviewing the conversation she has about moving in, and Sekai's there the whole time, and when Niki presses to talk to Ami about it now, Sekai seems to call Ami to interrupt the conversation (or be a part of it?) Unsure about her intentions:

posts.content_html_raw:
LoveBlueHairedGirl’s Himawari theory got me thinking up cracked potential theories of my own… and- okay so how about this?

Y’know how resets are able to mess with everyone’s perception of time and reality except for the Rooftop Apocalypse Squad? And also how reality can essentially be… rewritten entirely almost? (Examples: Ami getting crucified in Reset 6 but being alive again once the reset was initiated by Big Boy, Chinami coming down with a serious illness but being healthy again post reset, and of course we know of the many times Akira’s cognition has been rewritten, and now more recently Maya’s.)

Anyway, my point is: What if Sekai found a way to rewrite existence from beyond the grave? What if she’s able to return to life somehow?

We’re being led to believe Nao-chan was the last character added to the game, but… is it 100% definitely without a doubt confirmed? Or is Selebus perhaps hiding a sneaky little twist up his sleeve?

Just think about it. Sekai has appeared on the roof at the end of one of the resets before; the fifth one I believe. And Sekai is already possessing Kaori for a fact… why? To try and cling onto life in some form, obviously. Kaori’s recent events touch on the idea of rewriting history as well. It’s an interesting thought.

Imagine we go through a reset event, then once it’s initiated and Akira goes home: bam! Sitting right there on his couch.

“Hello, Aki-kun~… Did you miss me?”

And the sixteenth side character is added to the menu after the twist of all twists and a taunting message by the narrator.

“Oh, did I say Nao-chan was last? You really shouldn’t believe everything you hear, you know.”

Aw well. Realistic or not, it’s fun to imagine the possibilities.

posts.content_html_raw:
I have been very busy, but I was finally able to play the update, I enjoyed it a lot and I will leave some thoughts

and I start with the most beautiful and tender beginning
Totally unexpected but deserved, and the part where Akira before tells him to try to help Ayane has his touch.

The first conversation with Ami is captivating in a way and again the same voices, as when she had Akira confined.

Possibly easy referral to kidney transplant for kaori, now the scar is showed more explicit, then saying familiar mmm


I mean, coincidence oh no, a box with a child inside, and what's in Maya's boxes, a very famous theory long ago, so maybe maybe not.

lmao!
The fishing was adorable, and everything revolved around like the loss of a loved one. and the final part with Maki running was good haha

I consider this phrase in Akira's monologue very important, given all the insect symbolism in the happy event and for Selebus in general. It must have more background, or maybe I think about it a lot

Just peak of peaks regarding Yuki right now, Also another moment of good progress, we will see how the topic is cooked with Yumi and Sara

Sel has put everything into this patch with the color theme, and it is one of the great theories in this game, he likes to put a lot of trails of various colors in many scenes with more background and emotions It would be just one thing. and possibly the color machine that Kaori is building is something more real and not gossip. I think Kaori confirms being able to see Auras

And yes, as I suspected, The Frog was a gift and now the whole Frog Boy theme is more present.

It is almost certainly the same part as when they were looking for the first treasure, only more illuminated.

So according to Kaori, he's the good guy., curious, wasn't Kaori called the mistress of darkness, ironies of life

and here is an example of intentionally placed colors, showing the ancient green kaori, and the reddish purple tone, from the annexation of Sekai

another god, hahaha in the myriad millions that exist, manufactured, invented, real or mental, increasingly confusing, although the talk is interesting there are several analogies, between the flowers and the garden

Among the curious selection of images shown before finding the door, is the main street from the previous game.

Then there is the confrontation between pareidolia not wanting to enter, and wires yes.
The most important thing here is not them but how every time a god interferes or makes the Switch, Nao disappears from the world and then returns, also the exchange of day and night

We will return here later for sure

something comical, and finally Molly receiving W, Molly's talk was entertaining in her astonishment.

Nothing to say, it was cute haha and funny

Peak moment, genuine smile, and finally a great improvement in Akira, at least in this aspect... and in the end this was what ended up taking him out of the gloomy state, Ami moving up positions although she still has his little things. Ami has even more potential depending on how things go.
haruka his little background development is nice and well done it's okay

I'm not going to lie for a couple of seconds I thought, doing his tricks again Sel, or this is for everyone, nah but the last thing and I returned and cltr and that's how it was

Maya would be very proud

And Nao being a child of the stars. or something like that

the fucking plant council has its funny things

Important things, Nao's color changes to something more similar to Moyo

Then there is teenage Sara, spiders, cockroaches, and the moon, all symbolically important, and then floating glasses that I don't know who they could refer to.

Himawari possibly user 4

This part is very confusing but I'll leave this out because it caught my attention.

Touka going ultrahorny mode in her playful tone good good, until fall exhausted with pleasure

beautiful moment, in part it is not something that Sara has not thought about many chapters ago, and I see it happening naturally, but as things are with Niki there are many paths that could happen here, especially considering how things are going now with Sana

I can only hope, for the purity routes, for some redemption, that with harem route and dark route it is better not to expect much in the positive, hopefully in purity it will be well compensated because Sara deserves it!

good closing for the event of course I wanted more from Touka, but what will happen maybe on the beach/or in their next events, it promises
Molly blushing, and with a pretty dress, there is nothing more to ask for
and well some justice for Molly

Now if we talk about potential, cosplay 1 and counting
At the end I slapped all the Haruka/molly threesome hopefuls but surely there will be something more later on in Haruka on her scum path, and on her devoted sex slave path. and well that would be all, thanks for reading.

Hah, made almost the exact same statement a few pages ago.
Without Maya, it just seems pointless from the point of view of Sensei, similarly to how Makoto has been thinking of life ever since getting to know about the reset. The mental breakdown seemed like a good reflection of it.

It really made me lose interest in the game, though. The other students are nice side characters that provide some distraction, but none of them really matter to Sensei and the story seems even more random and up to the whims of the gods now. Might as well get rid of the protagonist completely at this point since he's been reduced to just another side character.
Click to expand...
That's why I personally wish, and this may be an unpopular statement, that this game didn't really go for the whole "supernatural/meta-existential" angle to begin with. I feel like it doesn't need it. These are good characters, and there's enough going on with them in their mundane, human lives that I feel like the other elements kind of get in the way of that. Especially since that with the whole "supernatural" side of the narrative, the characters have no agency whatsoever. There is nothing they can do about any of the things that are happening to them or around them.

The most excited I was for the more fantastical elements of the plot were around when Yumi and Tsuneyo were breaking out of the matrix and it seemed like they, along with Sensei, Maya, and Ayane were actually could do something to resist the world.

And Maya usually seemed to barricade certain hallways with them:

So even with the limited information i believe that could be what is going on in the relationship between him and her. Which would end up with some sort of hating love in his brain. And after the accident he suddenly had to take care of a girl that is so much like her.

posts.content_html_raw:
Excellent update. It skillfully delivered that authentic "Lessons in Love" experience I was craving. Sensei's Whale story almost hypnotized me, even. The whole scene was a trip. Good uncles were well served, too. The moms were lovely; cute reactions from Yuki and Maki. Sara was great, as always. Haruka's bonfire scene was impactful. I always enjoy Sensei's interactions with them. Ami was adorable.

I'm likely in the minority here, but what most engages me in LiL is the weird art, gods, supernatural stuff, parallel dimensions, resets, strange stories, etc. This update had a lot of that, so I was happy. I've always loved "denpa" content. There aren't many games with something as bizarre as fucking Floral Laura.

Of course, there must be lulls in this weirdness between updates, or the magic wears out. More banal, routine, drama-filled updates are necessities in an immense work like LiL.

The only thing annoying me still is that I can't really sympathize, let alone empathize properly with Sensei regarding Maya's "death." Feels overblown to me. I've seen people lose lifelong, devoted partners and not devolve into a mess of Sensei's level. I guess you can chalk it up to his mental illnesses or some subconscious, ingrained response from the millions of years the various "Senseis" spent with Maya, perhaps.

If that's the case, though, strange. If Sensei has these past influences, I don't understand why he doesn't show more attachment to someone like Yumi. Sometimes, when he has his episodes near Yumi, her outfits change quickly, as if they had met in many scenarios (they've been likely intimate as well since she also appears naked momentarily.) Does anyone remember if Sensei has proposed to anyone besides her (even as a joke?)

The impression is that many, or at least one of these past "Senseis" have been crazy about her.

I'm sure there's a good reason why he was so obsessed with Maya, but it seems I failed to grasp it properly.

My another crazy theory! This time is about Yumi being Akira's lover in the past loops. And with broken English as well!

My headcanon is based on some theory that Sensei and Maya truly were for gazillions years in these loops alternately replacing each other, like, at the beginning of the game it was Maya who kept the memory of the time loops, but now it's Sensei. But with some exceptions. Maybe during some of these loops Sensei was on the roof with Yumi, not Maya (or with her as well, but she just doesn't remember this thanks to gods' fuckering). After all, some God really shows interest in Yumi as well. And it is possible that one of the previous Sensei, at least the one before current one, was kinda in love with Yumi. It is possible she got resetted in one of the last loops before the game starts. That's possibly why previous Sensei was trying to communicate with her so much by inviting her over and etc. Also it can explain why even current Sensei feels some kind of comfort around Yumi and wants to fuck her even more than any other girl yet never fucked her. Like, Sensei never raped someone (not considering when Gods corrupting him (yes, I am talking about Sara moment)), but for some reason he attacked Yumi back in the start. Like, he does knows how good it feels to be inside Yumi. But, alas, he just kissed her, and for some reason she leaned into his kiss. Yeah, you may say she was doing this in fear to make him not to be so rough or something like that. But maybe it is her old habit of kissing him suddenly waked up? And fucking her would hurt his own mental health even more, somewhere unconsciously he knows that, that's why he didn't do something more than just a kiss.

It also explains why Sensei has some kind of hallucinations around Yumi so often. Like, he had the similar (or not so) hallucinations only around Ami (especially when he remembering Sekai), Niki, Noriko and Maya, when he was remembering his past. So, I think Akira did have something between him and Yumi. But it wasn't in the "real" past. It was inside the loops. Sensei had billions years to play with any of the girls, so it is possible he had a thing with every girl out of original 10 (12 if we consider Molly and Tsuneyo). So in some of these loops he might end up being together with Yumi, maybe even more than once.

She even may end up on the roof. Knowing she can understand loops it is possible she CAN survive through resets. And it is my headcanon that reset can be survived only by 3 persons at the same time (at least on the roof, who knows, maybe Church can protect Yasu from resets as well). So when Makoto joined the rooftop squad Maya was kicked out of it, leaving Akira, Ayane and Makoto. That's also why Yumi and Tsuneyo didn't survive the reset this time, because the squad was already full and neither Yumi or Tsuneyo had a child inside them (if only it is really the requirement to be on the roof). So it means... Either Yumi was pregnant back before the game started or she is a favourite plaything for one of the gods, likely Wires one. Or both.

So, my idea is that Yumi was on the roof back then, but something happened and she got reseted. Her losing memory caused him a great mental pain. And seeing that his loved one (the one who he loved as strong as Maya back then) totally forgetting him, and Maya being not here (or being an asshole who was glad to see her rival "dead"/didn't care about her "death"/totally forgetting her being on the roof) made Akira commit a suicide, completely ruining the loops and formatting his memory to the "I don't know anything" state. But seeing and interacting with her make him remember the past a bit, but it's just some quick flashbacks, a feeling that she should be his. That's why previous Sensei was trying to understand what is going on between them, so he bring her to his office. Yet only more painful memories were remembered which leads him to get reseted again. That's how current Sensei appears.

Why doesn't Maya remember it then? Well, remember one old event when Maya and Yumi were trying to bond over hating Sensei? They both realized they never talked with each other before. And Maya realized that she never thought of Yumi at all, totally ignoring her for bazillions of years. But hey, it contradicts my theory, right? WRONG. Maya should never rely on her memories, cuz as we know they got corrupted in some sorta way. And I WON'T believe Maya never interacted with Yumi just because Yumi is a delinquent who skips classes and Maya is edgy teen who doesn't like other people. After all, Maya Prime should been know about a loop before (the one before game starts) when Sensei was often bringing Yumi to the his/councilor office. But Maya Prime didn't know. But why Maya didn't know about that, considering she is basically his stalker? Well, the only possible conclusion there is that Maya's memory is basically shit and either one of the Gods deletes her knowledge of Yumi or Maya Prime never was in this loop.

But also... Maya did said in the start it is not her who is tsundere. And the only possible option left is Yumi. But why did Maya said that? well, I see 2 reasons: first — she IS the tsundere and it is the most tsundere way to say she is a tsundere, xd; second — unconsciously she knows it is Yumi, but knowing the fact that Maya doesn't care and doesn't even know much about Yumi, that's strange... Only if we consider the fact the memory of Yumi's presence on the roof was deleted and they knew each other better (just a bit, knowing their aloof personalities).

Well, it is copium, but... Both Maya and Yumi were in the team during beach Dorm Wars when Maya should have been capture Sensei and Yumi should have been protect him from Noriko(?). What if it wasn't just simple random choice by Selebus? What if it wan intentional? Maya was always TAKING Sensei. Yumi was kinda more about protecting him from shit and etc. And she did protect him in some sorta way: she didn't let him jump from the bridge and he does feel something strange when he is with her. Yet it is not like with Touka's mother-kind-of affection. It is like they both protecting each other. Maybe Sensei did comfort her in some of the previous loops.

What if there is actually more reasons for Akira not wanting to enter the Old District? Not only because of the memories about his true past, Niki, Noriko and Maya, but also Yumi? After all, she lives there as well. Yes, she doesn't appear in the memories about Akira's tutoring and simply didn't appear there, likely living with Yuki and caring more about survival than education. But it is possible that the newest scar on Akira's mind about this district was done by "Yumi Prime's" disappearance. Maybe the fact she is constantly chilling there makes Akira's unconscious hate the district even more, cuz it is where he and Yumi spent time together, where they bond.

As Algorist said: "Sometimes, when he has his episodes near Yumi, her outfits change quickly, as if they had met in many scenarios (they've been likely intimate as well since she also appears naked momentarily.)". And I completely agree with you! There is NO ONE in the game who has the similar things like Yumi. But also considering a huge amount of these outfits it basically means they were together for a long time. Knowing Yumi is poor she won't have much money on outfits, so it would be explained only by Yumi either slowly gaining money through some work, renting dresses or Sensei sugardaddying her (just like he is doing this with Chika right now).

I think a bit too much about this, of course, but that's what theories are, right? We put a lot of thoughts into the mix, and some of them end up being true.

But with some exceptions. Maybe during some of these loops Sensei was on the roof with Yumi, not Maya (or with her as well, but she just doesn't remember this thanks to gods' fuckering). After all, some God really shows interest in Yumi as well. And it is possible that one of the previous Sensei, at least the one before current one, was kinda in love with Yumi. It is possible she got resetted in one of the last loops before the game starts. That's possibly why previous Sensei was trying to communicate with her so much by inviting her over and etc. Also it can explain why even current Sensei feels some kind of comfort around Yumi and wants to fuck her even more than any other girl yet never fucked her. Like, Sensei never raped someone (not considering when Gods corrupting him (yes, I am talking about Sara moment)), but for some reason he attacked Yumi back in the start. Like, he does knows how good it feels to be inside Yumi. But, alas, he just kissed her, and for some reason she leaned into his kiss. Yeah, you may say she was doing this in fear to make him not to be so rough or something like that. But maybe it is her old habit of kissing him suddenly waked up? And fucking her would hurt his own mental health even more, somewhere unconsciously he knows that, that's why he didn't do something more than just a kiss.
It also explains why Sensei has some kind of hallucinations around Yumi so often. Like, he had the similar (or not so) hallucinations only around Ami (especially when he remembering Sekai), Niki, Noriko and Maya, when he was remembering his past. So, I think Akira did have something between him and Yumi. But it wasn't in the "real" past. It was inside the loops. Sensei had billions years to play with any of the girls, so it is possible he had a thing with every girl out of original 10 (12 if we consider Molly and Tsuneyo). So in some of these loops he might end up being together with Yumi, maybe even more than once.
She even may end up on the roof. Knowing she can understand loops it is possible she CAN survive through resets. And it is my headcanon that reset can be survived only by 3 persons at the same time (at least on the roof, who knows, maybe Church can protect Yasu from resets as well). So when Makoto joined the rooftop squad Maya was kicked out of it, leaving Akira, Ayane and Makoto. That's also why Yumi and Tsuneyo didn't survive the reset this time, because the squad was already full and neither Yumi or Tsuneyo had a child inside them (if only it is really the requirement to be on the roof). So it means... Either Yumi was pregnant back before the game started or she is a favourite plaything for one of the gods, likely Wires one. Or both.
So, my idea is that Yumi was on the roof back then, but something happened and she got reseted. Her losing memory caused him a great mental pain. And seeing that his loved one (the one who he loved as strong as Maya back then) totally forgetting him, and Maya being not here (or being an asshole who was glad to see her rival "dead"/didn't care about her "death"/totally forgetting her being on the roof) made Akira commit a suicide, completely ruining the loops and formatting his memory to the "I don't know anything" state. But seeing and interacting with her make him remember the past a bit, but it's just some quick flashbacks, a feeling that she should be his. That's why previous Sensei was trying to understand what is going on between them, so he bring her to his office. Yet only more painful memories were remembered which leads him to get reseted again. That's how current Sensei appears.

Well first of all, welcome to Lessons In Love! You’re in for a very long ride and quite the experience.

As far as your question, the grind and the search for where to go next can be made non-existent by installing just a couple things to your game:

1. The Guide Mod. It adds a Hints tab to your menu that lets you know exactly where to go next and exactly how many affection/lust points are required for said event. It even warns you on potentially important game altering choices. Very useful. It’s listed in the OP.

2. URM (or Universal Ren’py Mod). I would download this instead of the Cheat Mod, because not only does it do the exact same thing it does, but it’s capable of far much more at the end of the day. You can manipulate any variable in the game in real time and the grind becomes non-existent since you can just change the number of affection and lust points each girl has as needed. A true life saver and I’ll recommend it to anyone.
